Bramble.description: Cultivated with tough, thorny vines woven into your outer layer.

features.name: Bramble Ghoran
features.tldr: Your body reacts to close-quarters attacks by pricking attackers with sharp thorns.

Blossom.description: Features colorful, sweet-smelling floral displays that soothe emotions.

features.name: Blossom Ghoran
features.tldr: You can emit a calming aroma that grants bonuses against mental charm effects.
